summary: CommandWizard is a schema-driven WinUI desktop application that enables a single operator to construct CLI commands through a guided wizard interface. It supports command generation, history tracking, schema editing, and importing help text or command output to build tool schemas. It operates locally on Windows 10+ using .NET 10 and WinUI 3.
ecosystem_role: local-first operator-centric desktop utility for CLI command construction and schema management
capabilities: importing schemas from help text or command output
interfaces: command line for capturing help text
file system for schema and history storage
next_steps: Enhance schema import robustness with additional CLI help formats
Improve UI responsiveness and usability based on operator feedback
Automate schema validation and error reporting

potential_improvements: Add optional automated tests for UI components

Integrate with other Aptlantis tools for schema sharing

Complexity is medium due to schema parsing, UI, and integration with CLI tools.
